description: This Java class 'GatewayMetricsState' manages and computes metrics related to MQTT gateway connections, including latency statistics and session info, for the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: GatewayMetricsState
classes.description: Main class for tracking and updating MQTT gateway metrics, including session info and connector-specific latency statistics.

classes.name: GatewayMetricsState.ConnectorMetricsResult
classes.description: Record class encapsulating latency metrics results for a connector.

methods.name: GatewayMetricsState
methods.description: Constructor initializing session info and internal data structures.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates metrics data for all connectors based on provided GatewayMetadata list and server receive timestamp.

methods.name: getStateResult
methods.description: Returns current metrics results for all connectors and clears the internal connector state.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are any connector metrics stored.

methods.name: ConnectorMetricsState
methods.description: Inner class that maintains latency statistics for a single connector.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates latency statistics with new GatewayMetadata and server receive timestamp.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Calculates and returns the latency metrics result for the connector.
